items: NEW: Add experimental 1:1 voice calling (Zalo10 <-> Zalo): tap the call button in a chat to dial, new call screen with accept / decline, mute, hang up and call timer, plus ringtone and ringback. Group and video calls are not supported yet
NEW: Incoming calls bring the app to the foreground; if the app is minimized and the device is locked, a ringtone announces the incoming call

NEW: Add Feeds tab: see when contacts change their profile picture, cover photo, bio or birthday. Filter by All / Info / Photos, clear the list at any time, and optionally get a "Zalo10 Feeds" notification in BlackBerry Hub

NEW: Add Sticker Shop: download sticker packs and use them from the new sticker bar in the chat box (emoji | shop | packs | settings), reorder or hide packs in sticker settings, preview a pack's stickers before installing. Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP and animated GIF stickers
NEW: Add Reply card in Hub: long-press a Zalo10 message in BlackBerry Hub and tap Reply to read the latest messages and answer from a small card over the Hub. A short tap opens the chat directly
NEW: Add My Profile page: change your profile picture and edit your status / bio
NEW: Much richer contact profiles: status, gender, birthday, last active, join date, business info (address, website, email), full-size avatar and a live online indicator
NEW: Add group management: create groups, add members, rename a group and change its picture
NEW: Group Board is now enabled from the chat title bar. Polls live inside the board with a Vote button and a voter list
NEW: Add Mark as Read / Unread to the long-press menu in Chats and Groups, plus Mark all as read. Read / unread state syncs with the official Zalo app both ways

NEW: Add New Chat: start a conversation with any friend by searching their name (accent-insensitive: "nguyen" finds "Nguyễn"). Chats are built from your actual conversations and appear once they have a message
NEW: Add "N Active Chats", "N Contacts" and "N Groups" subtitles and unread indicators on the tabs
NEW: Group member names are looked up in the background and saved, so they show right after a restart
IMPROVE: Tabs moved onto the action bar (Chats, Contacts, Groups, Feeds, Invites, Shop), with the rest in the overflow menu
IMPROVE: Settings redesigned as a list of categories: General, Appearance, Notifications, Data & Backup, Cache Control, Support and Account
IMPROVE: Friends are fetched page by page and groups in chunks, so large accounts load without hitting Zalo's rate limit. The Groups tab fills instantly from the last sync
IMPROVE: Chat photos and media are downloaded through a queue instead of all at once

IMPROVE: Smoother Chats / Contacts / Groups tabs with large friend lists: avatars are requested at a steady pace and updated without rescanning the whole list. Contact picture changes refresh everywhere
IMPROVE: Bundled OpenSSL 1.1.1w: connections to Zalo's servers now work over modern TLS (1.2 / 1.3)
IMPROVE: Redesigned call screen and simplified Hub actions
IMPROVE: Zalo10Headless updated to match: shared code with the app, bundled OpenSSL, Hub taps forwarded to the app and incoming-call launch
IMPROVE: Removed the Update button from the About sheet
IMPROVE: Various other small interface fixes
FIX: Fixed connections to Zalo servers failing on BB10's old TLS stack
FIX: Fixed older group messages not loading (Zalo removed the old group history endpoint)
FIX: Fixed chats staying unread in the official Zalo app after you read them in Zalo10
FIX: Fixed the first search in Chats showing a blank page
FIX: Fixed a pinned chat that just received a message not moving to the top of the pinned block
FIX: Fixed the app slowing down while avatars load on accounts with many contacts
NEW: Add msg status indicators (Sent / Delivered / Read / Failed)

NEW: Add full support for Polls (options & voting): closed polls are hidden, only active polls are displayed; if too many active polls exist, they can be closed via the "Delete for me only" action button
NEW: Sync msgs from phone: only fetch msgs from conversations with at least 1 existing msg (required to retrieve the chat ID, as empty chats cannot provide a valid ID)

NEW: Load older msgs: to optimize performance with thousands of msgs, each chat loads a fixed amount of data; scrolling up triggers lazy loading for older msgs, keeping the app smooth and preventing crashes
IMPROVE: Cookie persistence via QSettings: you can now close the app or restart the device while still fetching 1-1 and group chats seamlessly
IMPROVE: Pin Board bar has been completely redesigned
IMPROVE: Zalo10 Hub notifications are now interactive: tap to open directly into the specific chat, or mark as read/unread and delete directly from the Hub
IMPROVE: Rebuilt Zalo10Headless: the experimental headless service from v1.3.0.x has been reworked for v1.5.0.x to handle background msg delivery even when the app is closed
IMPROVE: Add Terms of Service (ToS)
IMPROVE: Various other small interface fixes
FIX: Fixed sent/received images creating awkward gray space at the top and bottom
FIX: Fixed msg bubbles UI: bubbles now dynamically calculate their own size instead of using a placeholder safe-zone that stretches out via a laggy animation
FIX: Partially fixed auto-scroll bug: resolved the glitch where incoming msgs caused the chat window to jump back up to the first msg before scrolling back down
NEW: Add support for a variety of file types
NEW: Added support for GIF and WEBP stickers
NEW: Add support for links with thumbnails
NEW: Add UI support for incoming/outgoing call bubbles
NEW: Add support for sending voice notes (.m4a) and contacts (.vcf)
NEW: Add Hub Integration — Zalo10 messages no longer appear together with system notifications
NEW: Notifications now show a banner at the top of the screen (instant preview) and a separate icon on the lock screen
NEW: The incoming message notification ringtone has been changed from the system's essential.m4a to present.m4a to match BBM
IMPROVE: The attach button in the chat box has been redone as a sheet with a list
IMPROVE: Various other small interface fixes
FIX: Fixed images disappearing after logging out and logging back in
NEW: Small strip under each bubble showing whether it's your message or theirs
NEW: **Pinboard bar** showing pinned messages, plus board activity notifications (pins/note/poll created...)
NEW: **Forward** messages to another conversation via the new Forward Picker
NEW: **Copy & Share** messages — copy message text or share it out to other BB10 apps
NEW: **Reactions** — react to messages right in the chat with the new Reaction Picker
NEW: Create a calendar event from a message ("Create today's event")
NEW: Redesigned app icon (all sizes: 86/90/96/110/default)
IMPROVE: Chat bubbles are now split individually instead of being merged into one large bubble
IMPROVE: Photo messages always stand alone in their own bubble, no longer merged into a large text bubble
IMPROVE: Various other small interface fixes
FIX: Not receiving new incoming text messages (real-time WebSocket sync issue in certain cases)
FIX: Several crashes and QML issues introduced during development (About Sheet, Chat View, Groups Tab...)
FIX: Images disappearing after logging out and logging back in
NEW: **Update** button in About — check for the latest version right from the app
NEW: **Change List** button in About — read the full version history without leaving the app
NEW: Exclusive feature — view **recalled messages**, including text and photos (video not supported yet)
NEW: **Export log** button in Settings
NEW: **Export / Import data** in Settings (text messages without media, plus Quick Messages)
NEW: **Clear cache** button in Settings
NEW: **Search** everywhere — conversations, chats and messages, from the overflow menu (⋮) on every tab
NEW: Exclusive feature — create **unlimited Quick Messages**, including importing the one QM from your official Zalo account (the official app limits regular accounts to a single QM)
IMPROVE: Better overall image support
IMPROVE: Emoji panel colors adjusted so they no longer blend into the chat background
FIX: Leaving a group no longer fails to return you to the group list
FIX: Tapping a new-message Hub notification now actually opens the app
NEW: **Mute notifications** for individual conversations
NEW: **Block User** straight from the app
NEW: **Clear history** for a conversation in one tap
NEW: **Leave Group** with a single action
NEW: Photos now display fully for both sent and received messages (.png/.jpg/.webp) — previously only sending worked
NEW: **Active Frame** preview
NEW: Redesigned splash screen, now adapts to more device sizes
NEW: Press **S** on the keyboard to open search across contacts, chats and groups
IMPROVE: Dark mode is now stable and consistent across the whole app
IMPROVE: Friend requests now support Accept, Accept All and Decline
IMPROVE: Refresh button briefly disables itself after tapping to avoid hitting Zalo's rate limit
IMPROVE: Hub notifications can now be tapped to open the app directly
NEW: **QR code login** — scan from your main Zalo app instead of typing a password
NEW: Native real-time chat with a BBM-style interface
NEW: Built-in emoji keyboard
NEW: Send photos from your device storage
NEW: 1-1 and group messaging
NEW: Conversation list with synced names and avatars
NEW: Friend requests with Accept/Decline
NEW: **Dark Theme** for OLED devices like the Q10 and Z30
NEW: BlackBerry Hub notifications for both 1-1 and group chats
